_comment: CELPIP Speaking Task 5: Comparing and Persuading. The user chooses Option A or B, then persuades the other person, who prefers 'other'.

items.scenario: Your family is planning a one-week holiday this summer. You have found two options.

options.title: Beach resort in Nova Scotia
details: Hotel with a pool, right by the ocean

options.title: Cabin in the Rocky Mountains
details: Hiking trails and a lake for canoeing

items.scenario: Your family needs a new car, and you have found two options.

options.title: Used SUV
details: Seats 7 people, but uses more fuel

items.scenario: You and your partner are looking for a new place to rent. You have found two options.
Your family has decided to get a pet. You have found two options at the local animal shelter.

options.title: An adult cat
details: Happy to stay alone during the day

other.title: A fish tank
details: Nice to look at, but you cannot play with fish

items.scenario: You are organizing an end-of-year event for your team at work. You have found two options.

options.title: Bowling afternoon
details: Thursday from 3 to 6 p.m., during work hours
A fun activity for the whole team

other.title: Potluck lunch in the office
details: No need to leave the building

items.scenario: You and your sister are buying a birthday present for your father together. You have found two options.

options.title: Cooking class for two
details: He would learn to make Italian dishes

options.title: Smart watch
details: Tracks steps, sleep and heart rate
Something he can use every day

other.title: Concert tickets
details: The concert is a two-hour drive away
